about_the_game:
Coloring Voxels!

Taking Coloring Pixels to a whole new level in the highly anticipated 3D sequel! Don't just colour the outside of a 3D object; build it yourself, block by block! Build up your creations layer by layer, level by level, to create a whole diorama tens of thousands of voxels big.

Relive the calming and creative atmosphere of Coloring Pixels in our new 3D-based coloring game! From the music and art style to the gameplay and satisfying progression, relax and get creative with every level you build, in a format you already know and love.

Create Unique Worlds!

Every world in this game is made up of several individual levels that fit together in a larger themed 3D scene! Typically, each world is broken down into 16 individual levels that, when completed, fit together seamlessly to create a finished masterpiece. Create structures, vehicles, rivers, and more from the inside out, and in whichever order you like!

Relaxing, Refreshing, and Reimagined!

Making the game 3D has allowed us to enhance the experience even further: from satisfying coloring effects to adding new shader-based blocks, immersive particle effects, and lighting, altogether taking the genre to a whole new level.

You will discover hidden easter eggs inside objects as you progress, even if you can't see them in the finished piece!

Free!

Starting with 7 worlds of 16 levels each, that's over 100 levels for you to play for free! Hours of relaxing fun, and we are only just getting started.

Check out our Steam posts for the latest news on upcoming content!

short_description: Bring vibrant worlds to life block by block! Our revolutionary blend of Voxel Art and Color-by-Numbers lets you build stunning 3D dioramas from the ground up. As the second entry in our hit Coloring genre, this game evolves the relaxing joy of 2D coloring into an immersive 3D experience!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
